text: The real cell never matches the CAD model exactly. Parts warp, fixtures sit off their CAD positions, and the robot does not move exactly as modeled, so you must calibrate the TCP and work object.
RETRY re-executes only the instruction that raised the error, not the whole routine. To retry the entire pick, call the pick from a separate routine or use a WHILE loop.
A popup or halt in the program is not a safety function. Real safety relies on configured safety functions, guarding, and safety I/O.
The default UR description and SRDF define no gripper. Without an end effector to close, the lesson only plans the tool flange (tool0) to the pre-grasp and grasp poses.
ROS 2 is not the safety system. Safety functions live in the vendor controller and always take priority, while ROS only sends motion requests.

OSHA cites Swedish and Japanese studies showing that many robot accidents happen during programming, setup, testing, and maintenance rather than normal operation. NIOSH also found that many fatal robot strikes in the US (1992 to 2017) occurred during maintenance.

Under Article 6(1), an AI safety component of machinery is high risk when the machine must undergo third-party conformity assessment. Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 places machinery in Annex I Section B, requiring risk management, data governance, logging, and human oversight by 2 August 2028.
3.0 V per cell is the minimum discharge limit for a LiPo cell. Discharging below this voltage damages the cell, so robots should cut power before reaching it.

The local EKF produces a smooth, continuous transform in the odom frame for real-time trajectory controllers. The global EKF adds GPS in the map frame, where discrete satellite updates will not cause control jumps.
Matching a template of size w × h across an image of size W × H produces an output matrix of size (W - w + 1, H - h + 1).
The Nyquist limit requires at least two pixels per line pair to resolve a pattern. You need one pixel for the bright bar and one for the dark bar.
PROFINET RT bypasses TCP/IP for deterministic cycles of 1 to 10 ms. PROFINET IRT uses scheduled switching and hardware ASICs for sub-millisecond cycles with microsecond-level jitter.
Why should you change only one variable at a time when troubleshooting?
Mock hardware lacks a TCP pose broadcaster, while passthrough control and force mode do not work. The GPIO controller also reports a failure when setting I/O, so you cannot test a gripper on UR I/O.
Pins 2 and 3 are the only interrupt pins on the Uno, and the encoder takes pin 3. Connect the motor PWM to another PWM-capable pin, such as 5, 6, 9, or 10.
A stall or lost encoder shows up as high commanded PWM with near-zero measured speed. After a time limit, the FAULT state forces PWM to 0 and requires a manual reset.
Each team member submits a short statement describing what they did since the last milestone. This lets instructors grade the group project and each person's work separately.
Testing open loop with fixed PWM values reveals the motor's dead zone where it will not spin. It also checks linearity, providing a sanity check for the PID output.
